prerequisites.title: Prerequisites
prerequisites.intro: Before you begin, ensure you meet these operational requirements:
prerequisites.item2: Complete the business verification process required by your local region.

step1.title: Sign in to the Partner Portal
step1.item2: Select your target market/region from the dropdown menu.
step1.item3: Log in using your Lalamove Business account credentials.

step2.title: Access the Developers Tab
step2.item1: Locate the navigation menu on the dashboard.
step2.item2: Click on the Developers or API Keys section.

step3.title: Activate Live Keys (Production Environment)
step3.item1: Top up your Lalamove e-wallet with the minimum balance required in your market.
step3.item2: Switch your portal environment toggle from Sandbox to Production.
step3.item3: Generate your live production keys to start executing real-world shipments.
